I’m Max Fayniy — Video Editor & VFX Specialist. I don’t just edit videos — I act as your creative and technical partner, helping with ideas, pacing, and visual solutions at every stage of collaboration. Over 5 years in post-production, projects I’ve contributed to have generated more than 100M+ views combined. I blend high-energy digital content (YouTube, digital media, ads) with complex visual effects (VFX) and seamless 3D CGI integration for films and series. Clients and partners I’ve collaborated with include NAVI, Favbet, Inner Circle, DK Films, Quick Magic AI, hauntedstarbucks, YEKINDAR (FURIA), Slobozhenko, Mark Feygin, and other brands.
